# .CMPCT

> Project v0.29.0 · surface 0.29.k · canonical format r24.

CMPCT is an experimental general-purpose lossless archive/container. Performance is a core-release contract: benchmark wins and losses remain attached to committed evidence, while presentation-only changes use the alphabetic surface track.

Public stewardship: **CMPCT by FCMO AI** · **From the FCMO group**. This is provenance, not benchmark authority or a licensing statement.

## Publication authority
Canonical source and evidence live on `main`. `gh-pages` is generated static deployment output only and must not become a second source of truth.

## Visual quality authority
The restored pre-redesign hero/score/graph/light-band composition is the minimum presentation floor. Surface 0.29.h established the ratio-aware Chromium matrix across 16 representative width/height/aspect-ratio classes. Surface 0.29.i preserves that structural floor and adds the Ember Eclipse hero treatment: charcoal is the environmental default and brand orange is localized around the evidence/compression object as a sourced signal rather than wallpaper. Surface 0.29.k adds only the quiet maker-signature/provenance layer and preserves responsive.css as final layout authority.

## Qualification
The site distinguishes canonical revision-24 behavior from the research-frontier Mosaic/CMPNX11 results. Do not promote research-only grammar as canonical interoperability support. Raw archive-size comparisons do not imply feature parity.
